title: Asking for clarification
intro: Asking a clear question is professional, not a weakness, so check what the client means before you build it.
introTamil: தெளிவுக்காகக் கேள்வி கேட்பது பலவீனம் இல்லை; build செய்வதற்கு முன் client என்ன சொல்கிறார் என்பதை உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள்.

phrases.text: Could you clarify what you mean by real-time reporting?
phrases.tamil: Real-time reporting என்று நீங்கள் எதைச் சொல்கிறீர்கள் என்று கொஞ்சம் விளக்க முடியுமா?
phrases.note: Use this when a word could mean different things.

phrases.text: Just to confirm, you'd like the export in Excel, not PDF?
phrases.tamil: உறுதிப்படுத்திக்கொள்ள: export Excel-இல் வேண்டும், PDF-இல் இல்லை, சரியா?
phrases.note: Repeat back what you heard to avoid rework later.

phrases.text: Sorry, could you repeat that? You broke up a little.
phrases.tamil: மன்னிக்கவும், மீண்டும் சொல்ல முடியுமா? உங்கள் குரல் கொஞ்சம் கட் ஆனது.
phrases.note: "You broke up" means the audio cut out.

phrases.text: I have a question about the approval workflow.
phrases.tamil: Approval workflow பற்றி எனக்கு ஒரு கேள்வி இருக்கிறது.
phrases.note: Say "question", not "doubt", when you want to ask something.

phrases.text: Could you give me an example of how your team uses this today?
phrases.tamil: உங்கள் team இதை இப்போது எப்படிப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது என்று ஒரு உதாரணம் சொல்ல முடியுமா?
phrases.note: Examples turn vague requirements into clear ones.

steps.prompt: The client says they want "real-time reporting", but you're not sure what that means for them. What do you ask?
steps.promptTamil: Client "real-time reporting" வேண்டும் என்கிறார்; அவருக்கு அது என்ன என்று உங்களுக்குத் தெளிவில்லை. என்ன கேட்பீர்கள்?
options: What is real-time? I didn't understand.
Could you clarify what you mean by real-time reporting?
Real-time means what exactly, tell me.
steps.answer: Could you clarify what you mean by real-time reporting?
steps.explanation: "Could you clarify…" is polite and shows you're thinking carefully.
steps.explanationTamil: "Could you clarify…" மரியாதையாக இருக்கும்; நீங்கள் கவனமாக யோசிக்கிறீர்கள் என்றும் காட்டும்.

steps.promptTamil: Approval workflow பற்றி எனக்கு ஒரு கேள்வி இருக்கிறது.
steps.answer: I have a question about the approval workflow.

steps.audioText: Just to confirm, you'd like the export in Excel, not PDF?
options: Just to confirm, you'd like the report in Excel, not PDF?
Just to confirm, you didn't like the export in Excel or PDF?
Just to confirm, you'd like the export in Excel, not PDF?
steps.answer: Just to confirm, you'd like the export in Excel, not PDF?

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I have one doubt regarding the login flow.
options: I have one doubt regarding the login flow.
I have a question about the login flow.
I am having a doubt in the login flow.
I have one question regarding to the login flow.
steps.answer: I have a question about the login flow.
steps.explanation: To ask something, say "I have a question"; "doubt" means you think something may be wrong.
steps.explanationTamil: கேள்வி கேட்க "I have a question" என்று சொல்லுங்கள். "Doubt" என்றால் சந்தேகம் அல்லது நம்பிக்கையின்மை.

steps.prompt: The client's audio cut out in the middle of an important point. What do you say?
steps.promptTamil: முக்கியமான விஷயம் சொல்லும்போது client-இன் audio கட் ஆனது. என்ன சொல்வீர்கள்?
options: Sorry, could you repeat that? You broke up a little.
What? Come again?
Your voice is not coming properly, tell again.
steps.answer: Sorry, could you repeat that? You broke up a little.
steps.explanation: Apologise briefly and give the reason, so the client doesn't feel blamed.
steps.explanationTamil: சுருக்கமாக மன்னிப்புக் கேட்டு, காரணத்தைச் சொல்லுங்கள்; client-ஐக் குறை சொல்வது போல் இருக்காது.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Can you please explain me the requirement?
options: Can you please explain me the requirement?
Could you please explain the requirement to me?
Can you please explain me about the requirement?
Could you explain to me the requirement once?
steps.answer: Could you please explain the requirement to me?
steps.explanation: Say "explain it to me"; "explain" isn't followed directly by "me".
steps.explanationTamil: "Explain me" தவறு. "Explain the requirement to me" என்று சொல்லுங்கள்.

steps.answer: Just to confirm, you'd like the export in Excel?

steps.audioText: Could you give me an example of how your team uses this today?
options: Could you give me an example of how your team used this today?
Could you give me an example of how your team uses this today?
Could you give me a sample of how your team uses this tool?
steps.answer: Could you give me an example of how your team uses this today?

steps.prompt: Think of a requirement on your project that wasn't clear. Out loud, ask the client 2–3 clarifying questions about it.
steps.promptTamil: உங்கள் project-இல் தெளிவில்லாத ஒரு requirement-ஐ நினைத்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள். அதைப் பற்றி client-இடம் 2–3 கேள்விகளை உரக்கக் கேளுங்கள்.
